blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Union officers and stewards of Philex Mining Corp. on Monday marched inside the company’s Padcal mine in the Benguet town of Tuba to protest what they described as management’s efforts to pressure striking workers to return to work. In a phone interview, National Mines and Allied Workers Union (NAMAWU) Local 101 president Allan Sagun said management had been contacting workers individually and fetching some from their homes to report for duty. “Some workers were forced to go to work after receiving calls from their department,” Sagun said.
